POWERFIELD ENERGY OVERVIEW

THE PROOF PROBLEM

Everybody has to
take your word for it.

The people choosing who gets the job. The people paying for it. The tradesperson deciding where to work next. Three different decisions, and not one of them is made by somebody who has seen you work.

The difference is out on your projects. It is in the call your PM made when the drawings were wrong. The problem you found before it became the owner's problem. The work you stood behind after the invoice was paid.

None of that leaves the site. We bring it back, and put it where the decision gets made.

SOUND FAMILIAR?

Common problems
we see.

01

Nothing to show

You have finished a dozen projects and the only record is photos on a superintendent's phone.

02

Deals stall after the quote

Your estimator sends the number and then waits. There is nothing to send on Thursday that is not a nudge.

03

Stakeholders in the dark

The owner is in another city reading a written report. He asks the same three questions every month.

04

Crews you cannot fill

You are short on every job and your careers page has a photo on it you bought from a website.

WHAT YOU GET

One job, three pieces,
one link.

01

The project story.

Two to three minutes. The job start to finish, told by the people who did it and the client it was built for. Built for the pre-qual package and the bid presentation. Runs at the trade show booth and on your homepage.

02

The social cuts.

Ten verticals, fifteen to forty-five seconds each, captioned and ready to post. Not ten clips off the same reel. Before we film we agree the ten problems the content has to solve, the objection that keeps stalling your bids, the question the owner asks every month, the role you cannot fill, and every cut is built against one of them. Enough to post weekly for a quarter.

03

The page.

A written case study at a link that is yours. It covers the project, the problem, what you did and what the client said. Send it or embed it. Attach it to a proposal.

BUILT AROUND YOUR JOB

A plan, a day,
and we handle the rest.

You are running a job, not a production. The content strategy is agreed before we film, so nothing comes back that you cannot use.

01

We plan it before we film it.

We sit down first and name the problems the content has to solve: the objection stalling your bids, the question the owner asks every month, the role you cannot fill. Every deliverable is mapped to one of them before a camera comes out of the case.

02

Access and permissions, sorted first.

Whatever the site requires, we handle before anyone shows up. You chase nothing.

03

Up to a full day on site.

We work around the job. Your crew keeps working. We bring cameras, insurance certificates, PPE and releases.

04

Then we do the rest.

We interview, edit, write and build the page. You approve it once, in one place.

First cut in fourteen days.
If it is late, you do not pay.

The clock pauses while we wait on your approvals.

THE DEADLINE

A finished building
is just a building.

The proof is the work, and the work only exists while it is happening. Once the site demobilizes, no version of this can be recovered. Not at any price, not by anyone.

If there is a job running right now that you would want a committee to see, that is the one.

TERMS

The things
we guarantee.

01

First cut in fourteen days or you do not pay.

Fourteen days after we leave the site, the first cut is in your hands. A day late and the project is free and you keep everything. Only that first cut carries a date, and its clock pauses on your approvals.

02

We work around your job, not the other way around.

Up to a full day on site, on your schedule. We bring our own insurance certificates, PPE and releases, and nobody on your crew gets pulled off the work to stand in front of a camera.

03

If the footage is not right, we come back on our dime.

If what we got does not hold up, we book another day and cover it. No change order, no mobilization fee.

PRICING FAQ

A few things
worth knowing.

Why is the price the same for every client?

Because the deliverables are. Custom scopes are why other vendors take three weeks to send you a proposal.

What is the difference between video plus written and video only?

Video only is the films on their own. Video plus written adds the case study and its one page version, written from the same interviews. Same day on site either way.

Can I upgrade after the shoot?

Yes. We capture everything on the day regardless of package. Add the social cuts or the written assets within thirty days of the shoot at the difference in price. A Site Day upgrades the same way, with the full $2,500 coming off.

What if the project is confidential?

Then it runs as work for hire. Delivered into your systems and never shown publicly, to named recipients only. Same price.

How long until we see something?

About three weeks. A week to sort access and scheduling, a day on site, then fourteen days to your first cut. That part we guarantee. What follows depends on how fast approvals come back, which is why we do not put a date on it.

What do you need from my client?

Twenty minutes on camera and a release. We handle the ask if you would rather we did.

What if a job slips while we are on the Build Record?

Nothing is lost. Visits bank as credits, so if a project is delayed or an owner will not sign a release, spend that month on a crew story, a set of quote answer videos, or a Site Day on another job instead.

What do my supers need for Crew Capture?

The phone already in their pocket. We send a short shot list every week built for the stage the job is in, they film a few clips between tasks, and we do the rest. No app to install, no gear, and nobody from our team on site.

Do you work outside Central Ohio?

Yes. Central Ohio work is filmed by our local crew with no travel costs. Elsewhere we send a vetted crew from our network, directed by us, with the same deliverables and the same fourteen day guarantee. Travel is quoted at cost.

Can you cover more than one project in one day?

Yes. Three sites in one day in the same market, with shorter coverage on each. Ask on the call.

What if the weather turns?

We reschedule at no charge and the clock starts from the new date.

What if our approvals take a while?

The clock pauses. The turnaround is our time, not yours. If the owner sits on a release for three weeks, those three weeks are not counted against us, and the guarantee still stands on the rest.

Do we own the footage?

Yes. Your organized raw archive is included in every package.

The hard part
is already done.

You built it. You solved the problems on site. The only thing missing is proof that it happened.
